sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上，现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 届时，您可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日要闻。

sentences.en: Since 1947, India has granted the people of Kashmir a set of protections that guarantee their autonomy.
sentences.zh: 自1947年以来，印度一直赋予克什米尔人民一系列保障其自治权的保护措施。

sentences.en: Jeffrey Gettleman on why India just erased that autonomy.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里·盖特尔曼将为您讲述印度为何刚刚抹去了这种自治权。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 9th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月9日，星期五。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, tell me how you came to understand what was going on in Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，告诉我你是如何了解到克什米尔正在发生什么的。

sentences.en: So over the weekend, I have been talking closely with a local journalist who works for us named
sentences.zh: 周末期间，我一直与我们当地的一位记者萨米尔·亚瑟保持密切联系。

sentences.en: Samir Yasser.
sentences.zh: 萨米尔·亚瑟。

sentences.en: I've worked with him a lot.
sentences.zh: 我和他合作过很多次。

sentences.en: I've traveled across Kashmir with him.
sentences.zh: 我曾和他一起走遍了克什米尔。

sentences.en: He had told me that thousands of Indian army troops had flooded into the valley in the last few days, and there were barriers being erected.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，过去几天里，数千名印度军队涌入山谷，并设置了路障。

sentences.en: People were being called up for extra duty who worked for the government.
sentences.zh: 政府工作人员被召集执行额外任务。

sentences.en: Satellite phones were being passed out to police officers.
sentences.zh: 卫星电话被分发给警官。

sentences.en: And Samir was just describing this anxiety and confusion and sense of doom hanging over the valley.
sentences.zh: 萨米尔描述了笼罩在山谷上空的焦虑、困惑和末日感。

sentences.en: He gave me the impression that there was a big preparation for some type of clampdown.
sentences.zh: 他给我的印象是，当局正在为某种大规模镇压做准备。

sentences.en: And he and I had a plan that we were going to talk on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们原计划在周一进行交谈。

sentences.en: We were going to put together a story on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们打算在周一整理出一篇报道。

sentences.en: And he said, you know what, let me send it to you Sunday just in case something happens.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道吗，我还是周日发给你吧，以防万一发生什么事。

sentences.en: And he sent over a story about all these tensions and worries on Sunday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 周日下午，他发来了一篇关于所有这些紧张局势和担忧的报道。

sentences.en: And that was the last I heard from him.
sentences.zh: 那是我最后一次收到他的消息。

sentences.en: You couldn't reach him after that?
sentences.zh: 那之后你就联系不上他了？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I tried calling him many times.
sentences.zh: 我试过多次给他打电话。

sentences.en: I sent him messages.
sentences.zh: 我给他发了信息。

sentences.en: I sent him emails.
sentences.zh: 我给他发了电子邮件。

sentences.en: And what we learned was that the Indian government had shut down all communication from the valley on Sunday night,
sentences.zh: 后来我们得知，印度政府在周日晚上切断了山谷的所有通讯，

sentences.en: shortly after I had last communicated with our with our colleague.
sentences.zh: 就在我与同事最后一次联系后不久。

sentences.en: So what did you do?
sentences.zh: 那你当时怎么做？

sentences.en: So we had no way of communicating with people in the entire Kashmir region.
sentences.zh: 我们无法与整个克什米尔地区的人进行任何沟通。

sentences.en: So we waited knowing that something big was going to happen.
sentences.zh: 所以我们只能等待，因为知道会有大事发生。

sentences.en: And on Monday morning, there was an announcement that a speech was going to be made by India's home minister in the parliament, and that this would likely explain what
sentences.zh: 周一早上，有消息宣布印度内政部长将在议会发表讲话，这很可能解释了

sentences.en: was happening in Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔正在发生什么。

sentences.en: So I came into the office early, along with some other colleagues, we turned on the TV.
sentences.zh: 所以我和其他一些同事早早来到办公室，打开了电视。

sentences.en: Hello, and welcome to Rajya Sabha television.
sentences.zh: 您好，欢迎收看联邦院电视台。

sentences.en: You're watching the big picture with me,
sentences.zh: 您正在收看的是由我主持的《大局观》，

sentences.en: Frank Rauzan-Perez.
sentences.zh: 我是弗兰克·劳赞-佩雷斯。

sentences.en: An announcement with massive repercussions for Jammu and Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 一项对查谟和克什米尔具有巨大影响的公告。

sentences.en: And we waited to hear what was afoot.
sentences.zh: 我们等待着了解究竟发生了什么。

sentences.en: Jammu and Kashmir, a historic day, a massive day.
sentences.zh: 查谟和克什米尔，这是历史性的一天，意义重大的一天。

sentences.en: And pretty quickly, it was clear that the government had a very ambitious plan to change the status of
sentences.zh: 很快就很清楚，政府有一个非常雄心勃勃的计划，要改变

sentences.en: Kashmir and erase its autonomy that has existed for decades.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔的地位，并抹去它几十年来享有的自治权。

sentences.en: And the home minister took the floor of the upper house of parliament and began making this presentation about what the government was going to do, how it was going to change these
sentences.zh: 内政部长在议会上院发言，开始陈述政府将要做的事情，以及它将如何改变这些

sentences.en: constitutional provisions and what this means for India.
sentences.zh: 宪法条款，以及这对印度意味着什么。

sentences.en: And it immediately provoked an outroar on the floor of the parliament with opposition politicians heckling him and booing and screaming, but he just kept going.
sentences.zh: 这立即在议会大厅引发了轩然大波，反对派政客对他进行质问、嘘声和尖叫，但他只是继续讲下去。

sentences.en: And the news landed like a bombshell in India, because this is one of the biggest decisions the country has made about ruling Kashmir or any other state since India was formed in
sentences.zh: 这个消息在印度引起了轰动，因为这是自1947年印度建国以来，该国在统治克什米尔或任何其他邦方面做出的最大决定之一。

sentences.en: From what I can tell out of my window, because our house is a little fortified and we have a lot of security.
sentences.zh: 从窗外看，因为我们的房子有点像堡垒，而且安保严密。

sentences.en: Like I said, there's a deathly calm.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，这里死一般的寂静。

sentences.en: The weather's actually beautiful.
sentences.zh: 天气其实很好。

sentences.en: It's a nice, sunny, balming morning here.
sentences.zh: 这是一个阳光明媚、气候宜人的早晨。

sentences.en: It's about 12 in the afternoon.
sentences.zh: 现在大约是下午12点。

sentences.en: So I wasn't able to reach Samir, but I was able to find a activist, the daughter of a prominent Kashmiri
sentences.zh: 我无法联系到萨米尔，但我找到了一位活动人士，她是克什米尔一位知名

sentences.en: politician who somehow was able to make a voice recording and send it to me to give me an update of what was happening.
sentences.zh: 政客的女儿，她设法录了一段语音发给我，向我通报了正在发生的情况。

sentences.en: And there's absolutely no movement, no honks, no sounds of cars, nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 外面完全没有动静，没有喇叭声，没有汽车声，什么都没有。

sentences.en: Her name is Iltajah.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫伊尔塔贾。

sentences.en: And I did some checking to see who she was.
sentences.zh: 我核实了一下她的身份。

sentences.en: And her mother is a prominent
sentences.zh: 她的母亲是一位知名的

sentences.en: Kashmiri politician who had been put on house arreSt.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔政客，已经被软禁了。

sentences.en: So from yesterday, there have been a couple of developments.
sentences.zh: 所以从昨天开始，事态有了些进展。

sentences.en: My mother was previously under house arrest, but she's been detained now.
sentences.zh: 我母亲之前被软禁，但现在已经被拘留了。

sentences.en: I don't know if she was detained when I spoke to your correspondent yesterday, but they've taken her away.
sentences.zh: 我不知道昨天和你方记者通话时她是否已经被拘留，但他们已经把她带走了。

sentences.en: And Iltajah was really concerned and frightened about what was happening all around her.
sentences.zh: 伊尔塔贾对周围发生的一切感到非常担忧和恐惧。

sentences.en: At the moment, none of us are allowed to even step out of the house.
sentences.zh: 目前，我们连家门都不准出。

sentences.en: The confusion, the anxiety, the fear.
sentences.zh: 困惑、焦虑、恐惧。

sentences.en: I don't know how much longer are they going to snap internet services and not allow us to make calls or have any sort of access to communication.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们还要切断互联网服务多久，也不允许我们打电话或进行任何形式的通讯。

sentences.en: She felt like this was an assault on the dignity of Kashmiris.
sentences.zh: 她觉得这是对克什米尔人尊严的侵犯。

sentences.en: There's an absolute curtailment of civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 公民自由受到了彻底的限制。

sentences.en: We have no rights.
sentences.zh: 我们没有任何权利。

sentences.en: And it feels like Kashmir has been reduced to an open air prison.
sentences.zh: 感觉克什米尔已经变成了一个露天监狱。

sentences.en: That's the main feeling that people are having is just this sense of powerlessness that they don't like at all what the government has done, but they can't do anything about it.
sentences.zh: 人们的主要感受就是这种无力感，他们非常不喜欢政府所做的一切，但却无能为力。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, orient me a little bit here.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，给我梳理一下背景。

sentences.en: What is the story of Kashmir?
sentences.zh: 克什米尔的故事是什么？

sentences.en: The story is long and complicated.
sentences.zh: 这个故事既漫长又复杂。

sentences.en: August the 15th, 1947, Independence Day for India.
sentences.zh: 1947年8月15日，印度独立日。

sentences.en: And it goes back to when India was granted independence from Great Britain in 1947.
sentences.zh: 这要追溯到1947年印度从英国获得独立的时候。

sentences.en: A subcontinent larger than the whole of Europe becomes two self-governing dominions within the
sentences.zh: 一个比整个欧洲还要大的次大陆变成了英联邦内的两个自治领。

sentences.en: British Commonwealth of Nations.
sentences.zh: 英联邦。

sentences.en: There was a division in the Indian subcontinent between India and Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 印度次大陆在印度和巴基斯坦之间进行了划分。

sentences.en: India was established as a secular country in this part of the world with the Hindu majority population and Pakistan as a Muslim country.
sentences.zh: 印度被建立为一个世俗国家，人口以印度教徒为主，而巴基斯坦则是一个穆斯林国家。

sentences.en: There, beyond the snow-capped Himalayas, forming a barrier to all invaders lies Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 在那里，在白雪皑皑的喜马拉雅山脉之外，形成了一道阻挡所有入侵者的屏障，那就是克什米尔。

sentences.en: Kashmir is this absolutely exquisitely beautiful mountain valley between India and Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔是印度和巴基斯坦之间一个极其美丽的山谷。

sentences.en: And it has been contested bitterly between those two countries.
sentences.zh: 两国一直为它争执不休。

sentences.en: And Kashmir at the time was a princely state run by a Hindu Maharaja.
sentences.zh: 当时的克什米尔是一个由印度教大君统治的土邦。

sentences.en: And to make things even more complicated, it was majority Muslim.
sentences.zh: 更复杂的是，它的人口以穆斯林为主。

sentences.en: Four-fifths of Kashmir's population is Muslim, but the ruling class is Hindu.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔四分之三的人口是穆斯林，但统治阶级是印度教徒。

sentences.en: And the decision that he made was to not join either India or Pakistan and to remain independent.
sentences.zh: 他做出的决定是不加入印度或巴基斯坦，保持独立。

sentences.en: Well, that didn't last very long because just within a couple months of independence in 1947,
sentences.zh: 但这并没有持续多久，因为在1947年独立后仅仅几个月，

sentences.en: militants from Pakistan invaded Kashmir and the Maharaja went running to India for help.
sentences.zh: 来自巴基斯坦的武装分子入侵了克什米尔，大君跑向印度寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And India said, basically, okay, we will help you drive these invaders out.
sentences.zh: 印度基本上说，好吧，我们会帮你把这些入侵者赶出去。

sentences.en: But part of the deal is you have to agree to join the state of India.
sentences.zh: 但条件是你必须同意加入印度。

sentences.en: When the Maharaja greeted the Indian premier, it became clear to all observers that the proposed
sentences.zh: 当大君迎接印度总理时，所有观察家都清楚，提议的

sentences.en: plebiscite was as good as settled and that Kashmir would vote to remain within the Indian dominion.
sentences.zh: 全民公投已成定局，克什米尔将投票决定留在印度领土内。

sentences.en: So the Maharaja made a decision to do that.
sentences.zh: 所以大君决定这样做。

sentences.en: The Indian army would clear all invaders from their soil.
sentences.zh: 印度军队将从他们的土地上清除所有入侵者。

sentences.en: In the western part of the province, tribesmen are now in full retreat.
sentences.zh: 在省份西部，部落武装人员目前正在全面撤退。

sentences.en: But he put special conditions on his joining India.
sentences.zh: 但他对加入印度提出了特殊条件。

sentences.en: And some of those conditions were granting Kashmir a special degree of autonomy.
sentences.zh: 其中一些条件是给予克什米尔一定程度的特殊自治权。

sentences.en: The area would still have its own constitution, its own prime minister, rights to pass its own laws.
sentences.zh: 该地区仍将拥有自己的宪法、自己的总理，以及通过自己法律的权利。

sentences.en: And that was the compromise between the two sides.
sentences.zh: 这就是双方达成的妥协。

sentences.en: So Kashmir would have its own separate identity.
sentences.zh: 所以克什米尔将拥有自己独立的身份。

sentences.en: But in the late 80s, early 90s, a huge conflict erupted.
sentences.zh: 但在80年代末90年代初，一场巨大的冲突爆发了。

sentences.en: And many people in Kashmir wanted independence from India.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔的许多人想要脱离印度独立。

sentences.en: They didn't want to be part of India anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们不想再成为印度的一部分了。

sentences.en: Some of it had to do with religion because India is majority Hindu.
sentences.zh: 其中一些原因与宗教有关，因为印度以印度教徒为主。

sentences.en: Kashmir is majority Muslim.
sentences.zh: 克什米尔以穆斯林为主。

sentences.en: Some wanted to join Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 有些人想加入巴基斯坦。

sentences.en: And Pakistan took advantage of this.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦利用了这一点。

sentences.en: They sent thousands of militants across the border from Pakistan into Kashmir to fight against the Indian army.
sentences.zh: 他们派遣数千名武装分子越过巴基斯坦边境进入克什米尔，与印度军队作战。

sentences.en: And it turned the place into a bloodbath.
sentences.zh: 这把那个地方变成了一场血腥屠杀。

sentences.en: Thousands of civilians were killed.
sentences.zh: 数千名平民被杀。

sentences.en: Militants were fighting soldiers.
sentences.zh: 武装分子在与士兵作战。

sentences.en: Bombs were going off all over the place.
sentences.zh: 炸弹到处爆炸。

sentences.en: Civilians were being dragged into the battle against their will to fight for either the government or for the militancy.
sentences.zh: 平民被强行拖入战斗，被迫为政府或武装组织效力。

sentences.en: And the place was just cast into chaos and bloodshed and turmoil, grinding the economy to a halt, taking thousands of lives and changing the character of it.
sentences.zh: 那个地方陷入了混乱、流血和动荡，经济停滞，数千人丧生，性质也发生了改变。

sentences.en: So it sounds like by not choosing to fully be a part of India or Pakistan, Kashmir becomes a kind of tortured place in between the two that's tugged at by both.
sentences.zh: 所以听起来，由于没有选择完全加入印度或巴基斯坦，克什米尔变成了一个夹在两者之间、备受折磨且被双方拉扯的地方。

sentences.en: Yeah, and Kashmir has really expressed that frustration that they feel like they've been used by both.
sentences.zh: 是的，克什米尔确实表达了这种挫败感，他们觉得被双方利用了。

sentences.en: That Pakistan was using the Kashmir youth to fight against India, and India has turned Kashmir into a buffer zone against Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 巴基斯坦利用克什米尔青年对抗印度，而印度则把克什米尔变成了对抗巴基斯坦的缓冲区。

sentences.en: And the result is this just stagnation and depression.
sentences.zh: 结果就是这种停滞和压抑。

sentences.en: The villages are really run down.
sentences.zh: 村庄真的很破败。

sentences.en: You don't see many stores.
sentences.zh: 你看不到多少商店。

sentences.en: You see a lot of old cars.
sentences.zh: 你看到很多旧车。

sentences.en: I've been in places where the moment you drive in, you're just kind of swarmed by a bunch of curious young men who aren't working.
sentences.zh: 我曾去过一些地方，刚开车进去，就会被一群无所事事、充满好奇的年轻人围住。

sentences.en: You don't hear explosions or gunfire.
sentences.zh: 你听不到爆炸声或枪声。

sentences.en: But you see just tons of soldiers and paramilitary officers.
sentences.zh: 但你看到大量的士兵和准军事人员。

sentences.en: You see lots of sandbags and barbed wire and checkpoints.
sentences.zh: 你看到很多沙袋、铁丝网和检查站。

sentences.en: It feels like an occupied territory.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像是被占领的领土。

sentences.en: And that's another piece of it are these protests.
sentences.zh: 另一部分是这些抗议活动。

sentences.en: There's often protests against the Indian rule in the towns, in the villages.
sentences.zh: 在城镇和村庄里，经常有反对印度统治的抗议活动。

sentences.en: There's just a lot of anger there.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多愤怒。

sentences.en: And part of that anger is people feel like they're marginalized, that they're not taken seriously in India.
sentences.zh: 这种愤怒的部分原因是人们感到被边缘化，觉得在印度不被重视。

sentences.en: They don't have any of their own rights.
sentences.zh: 他们没有任何自己的权利。

sentences.en: They don't enjoy their own freedoMs.
sentences.zh: 他们享受不到自己的自由。

sentences.en: And that's bred this small but stubborn militancy that the Indian military is able to kind of take out these militants one by one.
sentences.zh: 这滋生了一种规模虽小但顽固的武装运动，印度军队能够一个接一个地消灭这些武装分子。

sentences.en: But then there's more young guys that want to join.
sentences.zh: 但随后又有更多的年轻人想要加入。

sentences.en: And it just goes on and on and on.
sentences.zh: 就这样没完没了地持续下去。

sentences.en: So young men in Kashmir have become radicalized and militant because of their frustration with being in this position.
sentences.zh: 所以克什米尔的年轻人因为对这种处境的挫败感而变得激进和好战。

sentences.en: And that fuels the narrative that Kashmir is a place that needs to be clamped down on.
sentences.zh: 这助长了一种叙事，即克什米尔是一个需要被严厉镇压的地方。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And it's been stuck in that cycle for, you know, almost 30 years now.
sentences.zh: 而且这种情况已经陷入了那种循环，你知道，差不多有30年了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, the situation in Kashmir has been deeply unstable now for decades.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，克什米尔局势几十年来一直处于极度不稳定的状态。

sentences.en: So what changed?
sentences.zh: 那么，发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: What finally tipped that brought us to this point?
sentences.zh: 究竟是什么最终导致了我们走到这一步？

sentences.en: A big piece of this is the rise of Narendra Modi, India's prime minister.
sentences.zh: 很大一部分原因是印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的崛起。

sentences.en: He is a Hindu nationalist and is pushing a strong nationalist agenda that prioritizes the Hindu religion.
sentences.zh: 他是一位印度教民族主义者，正在推行强硬的民族主义议程，将印度教置于优先地位。

sentences.en: And Modi has been talking for years about reorganizing Kashmir and ending this problem once and for all of the militancy and the troubles inside Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 莫迪多年来一直谈论要重组克什米尔，彻底解决克什米尔内部的激进主义和动乱问题。

sentences.en: We are trying to bring the majority of such youngsters into the mainstream who have been inspired by foreign propaganda and are attacking their own nation.
sentences.zh: 我们正试图将大多数受外国宣传煽动、攻击自己国家的年轻人带回主流社会。

sentences.en: And he was just re-elected a few months ago by an enormous margin.
sentences.zh: 而且他在几个月前刚刚以巨大的优势获得连任。

sentences.en: And that gave them a lot of momentum.
sentences.zh: 这给了他们很大的推动力。

sentences.en: There's no alternative to peace and cooperation.
sentences.zh: 和平与合作是唯一的出路。

sentences.en: My advice to such youngsters who have chosen a different path is to rejoin the mainstream as typified by their own family and parents.
sentences.zh: 我给那些选择了不同道路的年轻人的建议是，回归到他们家人和父母所代表的主流社会中来。

sentences.en: Their participation is required in the development of Jammu and Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 查谟和克什米尔的发展需要他们的参与。

sentences.en: So Modi's government came up with this plan, dividing Kashmir into two federal territories, make it a part of India much more than it's ever been.
sentences.zh: 所以莫迪政府提出了这个计划，将克什米尔划分为两个联邦领土，使其比以往任何时候都更紧密地成为印度的一部分。

sentences.en: And it would make it easier for Indians outside of Kashmir to move into the area and change the demography.
sentences.zh: 这将使克什米尔以外的印度人更容易迁入该地区并改变人口结构。

sentences.en: And that's the big fear.
sentences.zh: 而这正是最大的担忧。

sentences.en: This is the first step.
sentences.zh: 这只是第一步。

sentences.en: But it's a legal administrative step.
sentences.zh: 但这是一个合法的行政步骤。

sentences.en: And the next will be an influx of Indians that will come cruising into Kashmir, buying land, setting up businesses.
sentences.zh: 接下来将会有大批印度人涌入克什米尔，购买土地，建立企业。

sentences.en: And soon Kashmiris will be minorities in their own homeland.
sentences.zh: 很快，克什米尔人就会在自己的家园中成为少数群体。

sentences.en: The fear and the reality, it seems, is that India is deliberately swallowing up Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 恐惧和现实似乎是，印度正在蓄意吞并克什米尔。

sentences.en: Not so that it can maintain what it is, but so that it can completely turn it into the rest of India.
sentences.zh: 不是为了保持它原本的样子，而是为了将其彻底变成印度其他地区的样子。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the worry is, by swallowing up Kashmir, that's going to raise tensions with Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 令人担忧的是，吞并克什米尔会加剧与巴基斯坦的紧张关系。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, if you are India, why not just let Kashmir go instead of absorbing it?
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，如果你是印度，为什么不干脆放手克什米尔，而不是吸收它呢？

sentences.en: If this is a majority Muslim territory that is constantly creating conflict with India, why not just kind of cut it loose?
sentences.zh: 如果这是一个穆斯林占多数的领土，且不断与印度制造冲突，为什么不干脆切断联系呢？

sentences.en: That's a great question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的问题。

sentences.en: One reason why India doesn't want to do that is they're afraid that Pakistan would move into Kashmir and be even closer to New Delhi, the capital,
sentences.zh: 印度不想这样做的原因之一是，他们担心巴基斯坦会进入克什米尔，从而更接近首都新德里，

sentences.en: and they'd be able to strike the heartland of India more easily.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就能更容易地打击印度的腹地。

sentences.en: That's one.
sentences.zh: 这是一个原因。

sentences.en: Another reason is that India is a federation of many different diverse territories.
sentences.zh: 另一个原因是，印度是一个由许多不同多元领土组成的联邦。

sentences.en: And if you let one spin off, others might soon follow suit.
sentences.zh: 如果你让一个地区脱离，其他地区可能很快也会效仿。

sentences.en: And there are independence movements and rebel movements in other parts of India.
sentences.zh: 印度其他地区也存在独立运动和反叛运动。

sentences.en: And India is worried that if Kashmir breaks off, other parts of the country would break off.
sentences.zh: 印度担心如果克什米尔脱离，国家其他部分也会随之分裂。

sentences.en: And any tensions between India and Pakistan kind of hold this whole region in tension because they're the two biggest players, they fought wars against each other before,
sentences.zh: 印度和巴基斯坦之间的任何紧张关系都会让整个地区处于紧张状态，因为他们是两个最大的参与者，他们之前曾爆发过战争，

sentences.en: they have nuclear weapons, and they have this religious divide between them that's very easy to stir up people on either side.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有核武器，而且他们之间存在着很容易煽动双方民众的宗教分歧。

sentences.en: And so a messy Kashmir is just a problem for a lot of people far away from Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 所以，一个混乱的克什米尔对许多远离克什米尔的人来说都是一个问题。

sentences.en: So bring us back to Monday and the way that things played out.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们回到周一，看看事情是如何发展的。

sentences.en: India had cut the phones in Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 印度切断了克什米尔的电话通讯。

sentences.en: It sounds like that was a way to suppress this militancy and keep people from connecting with each other and organizing against India.
sentences.zh: 听起来这是一种压制激进主义、阻止人们相互联系并组织起来反对印度的方式。

sentences.en: What do we know about what's happened in Kashmir in the time since?
sentences.zh: 关于此后克什米尔发生的事情，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: So once the announcement was made on the floor of the parliament that this dramatic change was being done to Kashmir,
sentences.zh: 所以，当议会宣布对克什米尔进行这一重大变革时，

sentences.en: we realized why all the troops had been bussed into the valley in the weeks before and why the authorities had cut the internet and severed landline connections.
sentences.zh: 我们意识到为什么在过去几周里所有的军队都被用巴士运往山谷，以及为什么当局切断了互联网并断开了固定电话连接。

sentences.en: They were worried that once the announcement was made, there would be an outburst of violence, of protests, of rioting, maybe militant attacks.
sentences.zh: 他们担心一旦宣布这一消息，就会爆发暴力、抗议、骚乱，甚至可能是激进分子的袭击。

sentences.en: And the Indian government was trying to get ahead of that and just put everything in place to clamp down really hard on Kashmir so there could be no unreSt.
sentences.zh: 印度政府试图抢先一步，采取一切措施严厉镇压克什米尔，以确保不会出现动荡。

sentences.en: Since then, the clampdown has remained really tight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，镇压一直非常严厉。

sentences.en: I still can't get in touch with our journaliSt.
sentences.zh: 我仍然无法联系到我们的记者。

sentences.en: I haven't spoken to him since Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我从周日开始就没和他通过话了。

sentences.en: The information we have is that Kashmir is pretty quiet.
sentences.zh: 我们掌握的信息是，克什米尔目前相当安静。

sentences.en: Most people are staying indoors, inside.
sentences.zh: 大多数人待在室内，不出门。

sentences.en: There's a curfew in place.
sentences.zh: 宵禁已经实施。

sentences.en: Soldiers are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是士兵。

sentences.en: And the people there are just kind of stunned that this has happened, but they're not able to do much because it's basically illegal to move around outside.
sentences.zh: 那里的人们对发生的事情感到震惊，但他们无能为力，因为在外面走动基本上是非法的。

sentences.en: And another thing that was surprising was how much support Modi's decision has received across the political spectrum.
sentences.zh: 另一件令人惊讶的事情是，莫迪的决定在整个政治光谱中获得了多大的支持。

sentences.en: Opposition parties that oppose Modi's government on many fronts have backed him on this because Kashmir is seen as a nationalistic issue, one that stirs up feelings of patriotism.
sentences.zh: 在许多方面反对莫迪政府的反对党也支持他，因为克什米尔被视为一个民族主义问题，一个能激起爱国情怀的问题。

sentences.en: There's fears about Pakistan.
sentences.zh: 人们对巴基斯坦存在恐惧。

sentences.en: So his decision has been incredibly popular.
sentences.zh: 所以他的决定非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: Just about all of India has been behind it except Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 除了克什米尔，几乎整个印度都支持这一决定。

sentences.en: I'm struck that this is popular in so much of India, even though India is a democracy.
sentences.zh: 令我震惊的是，尽管印度是一个民主国家，但这一决定在印度大部分地区却很受欢迎。

sentences.en: And what was done in Kashmir could not possibly be less democratic, turning off people's phones, literally depriving them of the ability to communicate.
sentences.zh: 而且在克什米尔所做的事情绝非民主，切断人们的电话，实际上剥夺了他们沟通的能力。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's suppressing dissent.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是在压制异议。

sentences.en: It's not allowing any channel of criticism.
sentences.zh: 它不允许任何批评渠道存在。

sentences.en: It is eliminating the voice of Kashmir when it's their fate that is being changed.
sentences.zh: 当克什米尔人的命运被改变时，它却消除了他们的声音。

sentences.en: So they have no say in what's happened or even allowed to react to it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们对发生的事情没有发言权，甚至不允许做出反应。

sentences.en: That bothers some people in India.
sentences.zh: 这让印度的一些人感到不安。

sentences.en: There's been intellectuals that have been very disturbed and say this is a threat to democracy.
sentences.zh: 有一些知识分子感到非常不安，并称这是对民主的威胁。

sentences.en: It's a threat to India's secular identity.
sentences.zh: 这是对印度世俗身份的威胁。

sentences.en: There's been a legal challenge already filed,
sentences.zh: 已经有人提起了法律挑战，

sentences.en: and there will probably be others saying that the Modi government did not have the constitutional authority to unilaterally change Kashmir's status.
sentences.zh: 而且可能还会有其他人声称莫迪政府没有宪法权力单方面改变克什米尔的地位。

sentences.en: But the majority of Indians see Kashmir as a trouble zone, as a place for Pakistan to meddle,
sentences.zh: 但大多数印度人将克什米尔视为一个麻烦地区，一个巴基斯坦可以干预的地方，

sentences.en: and they are happy that the government has taken a strong stand on what they think could be a solution to the conflict.
sentences.zh: 他们很高兴政府对他们认为可能是冲突解决方案的问题采取了强硬立场。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, as we've been talking, so many global conflicts have come to mind.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，在我们交谈时，我想到了许多全球冲突。

sentences.en: And China and Hong Kong, China and the Uyghurs, Israel and the Palestinians, Russia and Crimea could kind of go on.
sentences.zh: 中国和香港，中国和维吾尔族，以色列和巴勒斯坦，俄罗斯和克里米亚，这样的例子不胜枚举。

sentences.en: I wonder where you think Kashmir fits.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你认为克什米尔处于什么位置。

sentences.en: Maybe it sounds like just another intractable conflict that people outside of the area just don't really need to care about.
sentences.zh: 也许听起来这只是另一个棘手的冲突，该地区以外的人根本不需要关心。

sentences.en: I think it's different in a couple ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为它在几个方面有所不同。

sentences.en: I think it's an especially difficult conflict to solve because of the issues of religion and history and identity and just the years of bad blood.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个特别难以解决的冲突，因为涉及宗教、历史、身份认同以及多年的积怨。

sentences.en: But I also think that unlike these other ones you've mentioned, not a lot of people are watching Kashmir.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为，与你提到的其他冲突不同，没有多少人在关注克什米尔。

sentences.en: It's kind of like the forgotten conflict.
sentences.zh: 它就像是被遗忘的冲突。

sentences.en: And I think that's one reason why this has happened, that India has taken this drastic step, because nobody was really paying attention.
sentences.zh: 我认为这也是导致这种情况发生的原因之一，即印度采取了这一激进步骤，因为没有人真正关注。

sentences.en: And they just kind of left this to fester.
sentences.zh: 他们只是任由这个问题恶化。

sentences.en: If the world had been so focused on Kashmir and its status, you're saying it would have been harder and perhaps less likely for India to have done what it did?
sentences.zh: 如果世界一直如此关注克什米尔及其地位，你是说印度会更难，也更不可能做出它所做的事情吗？

sentences.en: I think there would have been more consultation and pressure on India to respect the rights of the people in Kashmir, to speak to them, to see what they want,
sentences.zh: 我认为会有更多的磋商和压力迫使印度尊重克什米尔人民的权利，与他们对话，了解他们的诉求，

sentences.en: and try to come up with a solution that was more consistent with India's democratic values.
sentences.zh: 并试图提出一个更符合印度民主价值观的解决方案。

sentences.en: Instead, this was like a military takeover.
sentences.zh: 相反，这就像是一场军事接管。

sentences.en: And those usually don't win hearts and minds.
sentences.zh: 而这些通常无法赢得民心。

sentences.en: Jeffrey, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 杰弗里，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Of course, my pleasure.
sentences.zh: 当然，这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: In a speech on Thursday, India's Prime Minister, Narendra Modi, declared that ending Kashmir's autonomy was a, quote,
sentences.zh: 在周四的一次演讲中，印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪宣布，结束克什米尔的自治是一个，引用，

sentences.en: historic decision that would benefit India, Kashmir, and the entire region by eliminating the Islamic insurgency there.
sentences.zh: 历史性的决定，通过消除那里的伊斯兰叛乱，将造福印度、克什米尔和整个地区。

sentences.en: Atalji and Kurodo Dej Bhaktan, it's a dream now that has been fulfilled in Jammu Kashmir and Ladakh.
sentences.zh: 阿塔尔吉和库罗多·德吉·巴克坦，现在查谟、克什米尔和拉达克的梦想已经实现了。

sentences.en: But the decision was met with fury in Pakistan, which retaliated by halting trade with India and expelling India's top diplomat.
sentences.zh: 但这一决定在巴基斯坦引起了愤怒，巴基斯坦采取了报复措施，停止了与印度的贸易并驱逐了印度的高级外交官。

sentences.en: In a statement, Pakistan's Prime Minister accused India of promoting, quote,
sentences.zh: 在一份声明中，巴基斯坦总理指责印度推行，引用，

sentences.en: an ideology that puts Hindus above all other religions and seeks to establish a state that represses all other religious groups.
sentences.zh: 一种将印度教置于所有其他宗教之上的意识形态，并试图建立一个压制所有其他宗教团体的国家。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you on Monday.
sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受到严格控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当选举迎来了一群自称为改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场残酷、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》中，和我一起，莎拉·凯尼格，讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。
